definition: A context-dependent risk phenomenon or pattern concerning possible effects on value/objectives; distinct from records, descriptions, scores and workflow artifacts.
identity_rationale: Risk is the governed subject of risk discourse composed through relations among subject/context, scenario/event/consequence and assessment; forcing it into one UFO primitive would collapse competing legitimate views. Paper-1 continuity is governed by the stable semantic identity and the explicit #69 identity/continuity contract; mutable records, descriptions, assessment results, workflow/risk states, ownership and treatment history do not determine identity automatically.
diagram_instruction: Do not invent a derived-pattern/source stereotype; render explanatory pattern view linked to formal nodes.

definition: An entity, value-bearing object or externally owned item about which risk relevance is asserted.
identity_rationale: Entities of different externally owned kinds can contingently play the role of being the subject/object-at-risk in a risk context; the role supplies no identity principle.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A risk-relevant origin, source or contextual contributor that may participate in a scenario or event; causal status is not implied by the label alone.
identity_rationale: A source may be an endurant, event or situation; one UFO class spanning those categories would be invalid. Source-ness is contextual and is expressed through source/causal relations.
diagram_instruction: Do not invent a derived-pattern/source stereotype; render explanatory pattern view linked to formal nodes.

definition: A contextual state-of-affairs or situational condition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect without necessarily directly causing it.
identity_rationale: A contextual state-of-affairs may obtain and increase susceptibility without being a causal event or intrinsic disposition.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An occurrence acting as the initiating event for a risk-relevant event or process transition; an enabling condition is represented separately as a Predisposing Condition.
identity_rationale: For Paper-1 Core, a Trigger is an event/occurrence that contributes to the occurrence/transition of a Risk Event. Threshold triggers remain Method/Application semantics.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A possible or hypothesized risk-relevant configuration or event pattern used for analysis, distinct from descriptions and realized events.
identity_rationale: A scenario specifies a possible/hypothesized configuration involving conditions/events/consequences; it is neither the narrative describing it nor an actual occurrence.
diagram_instruction: Existing rdf:type SituationType class annotation is not an axiom typing scenario individuals as types; select and test an explicit modal/type-level representation before full OntoUML.

definition: A realized occurrence relevant to a risk context, distinct from a possible scenario and information artifacts describing it.
identity_rationale: A realized occurrence has temporal parts/boundaries and participates in causal chains; identity is occurrence-based.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A risk-relevant outcome or effect of an event/scenario; its magnitude/severity may be assessed separately.
identity_rationale: Core Consequence is the resulting state-of-affairs/effect after an event/scenario; an event-like consequence may be a profile refinement.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A disposition or condition that increases susceptibility to a risk-relevant event/effect.
identity_rationale: A vulnerability existentially depends on its bearer and can manifest in risk events; its identity is that of an intrinsic disposition, not a contextual situation.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A context-dependent condition or relation indicating how a subject/value is exposed to a risk-relevant source/event; assessment scores remain separate.
identity_rationale: Exposure is a relational state-of-affairs involving a subject and source/context; exposure ratings/amounts are separate assessment/method values.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An activity applying a method, context and evidence to produce one or more risk assessment results.
identity_rationale: Assessment is an occurrence performed by an actor/system over time and historically produces a result.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A method or technique governing how assessment evidence/context is transformed into one or more assessment results.
identity_rationale: A method is a repeatable specification that can be used by many assessment events and is not itself the event or result.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A contextual, time-bound information/measurement result produced by a Risk Assessment Activity concerning a risk subject/context.
identity_rationale: A result is an artifact/assertion generated by an assessment event and about a risk context; it can persist after the event.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An assessment result concerning estimated likelihood/probability/frequency under a specified method and context.
identity_rationale: This is an assessment assertion/result about likelihood under a method, not the likelihood quality/disposition itself.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An assessment result concerning magnitude/severity of effects under a specified assessment method/context.
identity_rationale: Assessment result concerning estimated magnitude/severity; distinct from the real-world Consequence.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A method-dependent overall risk rating/level produced from assessment evidence/results.
identity_rationale: Result identity remains separate from risk level value; no universal score formula.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A risk assessment result representing a pre-treatment/pre-control assessment context.
identity_rationale: Pre-treatment context is part of the result's assessment context, not identity of a second Risk.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A risk assessment result representing a post-treatment/control assessment context.
identity_rationale: Post-treatment context is part of assessment result semantics; it does not introduce another underlying Risk.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An information qualification stating confidence or uncertainty in a specified assessment result under a stated basis; it is distinct from estimated likelihood and from an intrinsic quality of the risk.
identity_rationale: The represented confidence assertion is information about an assessment, not likelihood or an intrinsic risk quality.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An information artifact used in context to support, challenge or contextualize a risk-related assertion, assessment or decision.
identity_rationale: The same information artifact can be evidence in one assessment and not another; evidence-ness is role/context dependent.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: Information about origin, derivation, version, agent, time and transformation history of an artifact/assertion/result.
identity_rationale: Provenance is a relation/history pattern over entities, activities, agents, versions and derivations rather than a single SemRisk foundational entity.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An activity that observes/measures risk-relevant phenomena and may produce observation results.
identity_rationale: An observation activity is an occurrence; no result/activity identity collapse.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An information/measurement result produced by an observation/monitoring activity and potentially used as evidence.
identity_rationale: An observation result is produced information; its value is not the Indicator specification.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A versioned specification of what is observed or computed to monitor a risk-relevant condition; each observation value or result is distinct from this specification.
identity_rationale: The versioned definition of a measured or computed indicator is separate from individual observations.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A versioned decision-boundary specification used with an indicator or assessment method; its comparison operator, scale, unit and applicability belong to the selected application profile, not to a universal risk formula.
identity_rationale: A comparison boundary specification belongs to a versioned method/indicator; a naked universal number is insufficient.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A decision/information artifact specifying a high-level selected approach for addressing a risk.
identity_rationale: A strategy is a chosen high-level treatment specification that can exist before execution.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An information artifact specifying planned treatment activities, responsibilities, timing or resources.
identity_rationale: A plan is a prescription/specification for future activities and responsibilities, not those activities themselves.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An activity performed to modify risk-relevant conditions, likelihood, consequences or preparedness.
identity_rationale: Treatment is performed over time and may use control mechanisms.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A persistent mechanism, capability or implemented measure used in prevention, detection, protection or risk treatment.
identity_rationale: Different bearer kinds can contingently function as controls. The controlling capability is intrinsic to a bearer, while 'being used as a control' is contextual.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A context-dependent role classification of persons, organizations or other eligible external actors bearing specified risk-management responsibilities; bearer identity is supplied by the external actor kinds, not by ownership.
identity_rationale: Persons and organizations can bear responsibility under different external identity principles; a universal sortal Role is not justified.
diagram_instruction: Abstract cross-kind role; subtype identity supplied externally; explicit support relations still required in editable model.

definition: A concrete responsibility/accountability assignment context that depends on an Actor/role bearer and any modeled governance participants, and is about the Risk, artifact, plan or obligation it concerns.
identity_rationale: A concrete normative assignment/relator context depends on the Actor/role bearer and any explicitly modeled endurant governance participants; it carries validity/history and is about the Risk/artifact/obligation it concerns. The derived Risk pattern is not forced to be a mediated endurant.
diagram_instruction: At least two distinct endurant participants; Risk is aboutness target. Opt-in named-witness shape is implemented.

definition: A managed repository/collection of Risk Register Entries for a defined organizational or analytical scope.
identity_rationale: Register identity depends on governed membership/version/scope of entries rather than the identity of real-world risks.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A governed information artifact in a risk register recording risk-related description, assessments, ownership, treatment and workflow information.
identity_rationale: A record is an enduring information artifact with its own version/history, distinct from the Risk it concerns.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: An information artifact describing a Risk Scenario, event chain, assumptions or consequences.
identity_rationale: A description is a textual/structured representation about a scenario; multiple descriptions can refer to the same scenario.
diagram_instruction: Adopt explicit artifact/content identity and helper taxonomy before selecting kind/subkind/role. Do not label information object as if it were a standard stereotype.

definition: A time- and context-bound state-of-affairs concerning the governed Risk context, distinct from assessment results, record/workflow progression and management/monitoring classifications.
identity_rationale: A Risk State is a time/context-bound state-of-affairs concerning the governed Risk context. It is distinct from assessment results, record/workflow progression, management attention/escalation classifications and monitoring task status.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A state of a management record/process indicating processing/progression, independent from the existence/state of the underlying risk.
identity_rationale: Workflow status characterizes the Risk Register Entry/process representation; values such as Open/Closed are quality values under a workflow scheme.
diagram_instruction: Current RDF vocabulary can denote reusable status values; an individual quality characterizes one bearer. Do not draw a shared status node as a bearer-specific quality.

definition: An externally owned enterprise/governance objective that may be affected by or provide context for risk.
identity_rationale: SemRisk references an external goal/objective semantic owner; it does not supply identity.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An externally owned enterprise capability that may be exposed to/affected by risk.
identity_rationale: SemRisk does not own capability identity. CM-PharmE Enterprise Capability is explicitly a mode in Pharma case.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An externally owned process/business activity context that may generate, encounter or be affected by risk.
identity_rationale: SemRisk does not own business-process identity; Pharma bridge preserves CM-PharmE perdurant.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A pharmaceutical ingredient/entity referenced in Pharma shortage evidence; the frozen CM-PharmE v1.0.0 catalog does not contain an API/INN concept.
identity_rationale: API/INN has no corresponding class in the frozen CM-PharmE bridge; preserve source identity without inventing equivalence.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A potential source of harm under safety/medical-device semantics.
identity_rationale: Safety-specific potential source of harm; not promoted to the neutral core.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A negative consequence affecting an entity/value under safety/medical-device semantics.
identity_rationale: Safety-specific adverse consequence; not promoted to the neutral core.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: An information-level indication suggesting a potentially important risk-relevant pattern requiring assessment; detailed semantics are domain-specific.
identity_rationale: A signal needs an explicit domain interpretation and adoption decision.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: Information/decision criteria used to evaluate significance, acceptability or treatment choices in a specified governance/method context.
identity_rationale: Risk criteria depend on a method and governance context.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A governance-level expression of the type/amount of risk an organization is prepared to pursue or retain, under a specified framework.
identity_rationale: Appetite is a governance expression, not a timeless scalar of Risk.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A governance/method expression of permitted variation/bounds around objectives or risk criteria in a specified framework.
identity_rationale: Tolerance is a governance boundary; not equivalent to residual/target risk.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.

definition: A polarity/classification construct expressing threat/opportunity framing without asserting separate universal Risk identities.
identity_rationale: Threat/opportunity classification depends on objective and context, not separate Risk identity.
diagram_instruction: Semantic category is not automatically an OntoUML stereotype.
